query.description: The query for which the feedback is given.

serverVersion.description: Server version of the client Application.

chatHistory.description:
Chat history of the user with the assistant.
The elements of the array are in increasing order of time. i.e. last element is the most recent {@link AiAssistant.QAPair}.

client.description: The client service from which the feedback is given. Could be jupyter, VSCE, community, etc.

feedbackIds.description: List of upserted {@link AiAssistant.Feedback} ids given by the user for this query.

modelMetadata.description: Information regarding the model used for generating the response. See {@link AiAssistant.ModelMetadata}.

feedbackContextId.description: The database id of the upserted {@link AiAssistant.FeedbackContext}.

title: A spec used to help bind the fields of {@link AiAssistant.FeedbackContext} together for the saving the Feedback Context.
name: AiAssistant.FeedbackContextSpec
